He sees the forthcoming update in lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, and Sjögren’s disease as an important opportunity to establish activity across several indications. data.title: INOVIO: EMA Filing for VOCERYQ Supports European Expansion; Analyst Maintains $5 Price Target
data.description:
Ram Selvaraju, an analyst from H.C. Wainwright, reiterated the Buy rating on Inovio Pharmaceuticals. The associated price target remains the same with $5.00.

Ram Selvaraju’s rating is based on several factors, led by INOVIO’s submission of a conditional marketing application to the EMA for VOCERYQ in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP). The filing could extend the therapy’s reach into Europe, where patients currently lack an approved nonsurgical option addressing the disease’s underlying cause. He views the application as a constructive step toward broader commercialization following the product’s accelerated U.S. approval, while maintaining the $5 price target.

His optimism is also supported by clinical and long-term efficacy data, evidence of stronger immune responses, and manufacturing information assembled for regulators. Prior orphan-drug status, EMA advanced-therapy certification, pre-submission consultation, and the CE-marked delivery device further strengthen the regulatory and launch foundation. With U.S. availability expected in early 2027 and supply sufficient for the initial rollout, these catalysts outweigh the remaining review and confirmatory-study risks.

data.title: Rein Therapeutics: Analyst Reiterates Buy and Maintains $4 Price Target Despite Selloff
data.description:
Analyst Jason McCarthy from Maxim Group reiterated a Buy rating on Rein Therapeutics and keeping the price target at $4.00.

Jason McCarthy’s rating is based on several factors, including the view that recent share-price weakness appears disproportionate to the available evidence. The interim RENEW findings remain blinded, yet 8 of 24 patients improved their FVC while 11 had only modest declines, a pattern that could be compatible with LTI-03 activity rather than a clear failure. Because IPF patients generally do not improve spontaneously, McCarthy sees potential in the early signal, while recognizing that conclusions must await the 24-week endpoint.

The trial continues without safety concerns, and its randomized design is assessing lung function, imaging, and repair-related biomarkers in patients receiving standard antifibrotic therapy. Rein’s $36.5 million cash balance is expected to fund operations through early 2028, including the full Phase 2 readout expected in 2027. Accordingly, he reiterated Buy and kept the price target unchanged at $4, viewing the selloff as an opportunity rather than evidence that the program has failed.

In another report released today, H.C. Wainwright also reiterated a Buy rating on the stock with a $8.00 price target.
